Tencent EdgeOne Makers Onboarding Guide


- Step-by-step tutorial video: SF Hackathon demo.mp4
- EdgeOne Makers Account Registration: https://edgeone.ai/register?s_url=https://console.tencentcloud.com/edgeone




Tencent EdgeOne Makers is a web and AI agent development and hosting platform that gets your ideas live fast — deploy agents, frontend pages, and dynamic APIs in minutes. Every deployed agent comes with batteries included: agent runtime, sandbox tools, conversation memory, full-chain tracing, and built-in models. Makers supports all mainstream agent frameworks, including Claude, OpenAI, LangChain, LangGraph, and CrewAI, with no language restrictions (JS / Python). The following instructions will help you get started with EdgeOne Makers quickly.


Install EdgeOne Makers Agent Tooling
1.  Install EdgeOne Makers Skills:
● Method 1: Ask your AI IDE in natural language to install the skill, e.g. “Help me install this skill: https://github.com/TencentEdgeOne/edgeone-makers-tools”。
You can also copy and paste the following command into your AI IDE:

Install the edgeone-makers-tools skill with `npx skills add TencentEdgeOne/edgeone-makers-tools`. After that, whenever you run EdgeOne CLI deploy commands, always pass `--area overseas`.
  



● Method 2: Install via CLI
npx skills add TencentEdgeOne/edgeone-makers-tools


2.  Relevant docs:
* Skills:
GitHub repo: https://github.com/TencentEdgeOne/edgeone-makers-tools
SkillHub: https://skillhub.cn/skills/user_cdc69ffo/edgeone-makers-tools
Doc: Deploy Projects to EdgeOne Makers with Skills
* MCP: Makers MCP
* Plugin: EdgeOne Makers Tools: AI Coding Plugin
* Learn more: https://pages.edgeone.ai/document/product-introduction
 
How to Deploy Your Project to EdgeOne Makers in AI IDE
After installing EdgeOne Makers Skills / MCP / plugin, you can deploy your web apps or agents to EdgeOne Makers within minutes.
1.  Tell your AI IDE in natural language, e.g. "Publish/deploy this agent to EdgeOne Makers"
2.   Makers supports login-free deployment: you can deploy your project first and claim it later by logging in on the dashboard.
  
 
Note: If you are deploying an agent that requires AI gateway credentials, we recommend logging in first so that the agent works properly. You can select the Global site when logging in.
  

3. Your browser will open the login page automatically. Register an account if you don't have one yet.
  

4. After logging in, simply wait for the deployment to complete. Once your project is live, open the preview link to view it.
  

You can also go to the dashboard to deploy your projects.
* Method 1: importing a git repo: https://pages.edgeone.ai/document/importing-a-git-repository 
* Method 2: uploading a file/folder: https://pages.edgeone.ai/document/direct-upload 


EdgeOne Makers Model Gateway
1.  EdgeOne Makers provides 500,000 tokens per person per month for calling built-in models. The available models are:
@makers/hy3
@makers/hy3-preview
@makers/deepseek-v4-pro
@makers/deepseek-v4-flash
@makers/minimax-m3
@makers/minimax-m2.7
@makers/kimi-k2.6
 
2.  You can view model usage on the dashboard under Models.
  

 
3.  Makers Models also supports proxying requests to multiple model vendors. You can bind each vendor's API key on the Models page of the dashboard.
Go to Models > Provider Keys to add your API keys.
Learn more: https://pages.edgeone.ai/document/models-vendor-keys-openai
